description: This file contains functions for generating JSON reports of PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) metrics, including transmission and reception latency, throughput, and CPU usage, formatted for use in a 3GPP-compliant system.

methods.name: generate_pdcp_tx
methods.description: Generates JSON object with PDCP transmission metrics such as latency, throughput, and CPU usage.

methods.name: generate_pdcp_rx
methods.description: Generates JSON object with PDCP reception metrics such as latency, throughput, and CPU usage.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a JSON report combining TX and RX metrics with timestamp.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the combined metrics report.
